# Atlas

> The developer platform for everyone: one atlas.yaml runs your stack, a native workspace runs your agents. Atlas is a dev environment by CodeAtlas, available for macOS, Windows and Linux: one `atlas.yaml` starts your whole stack (infra, services, health checks, dependencies, restarts); Atlas Desktop adds a Zed-style workspace, a live project panel, logs built for real traffic, a GPU terminal (macOS; xterm.js terminals on Windows and Linux) and AI agents (omp, Claude Code, Codex) in parallel git worktrees; an MCP server lets agents read logs and control services. Open source, MIT or Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/codeatlasdev/atlas (MIT or Apache-2.0). Releases: https://github.com/codeatlasdev/atlas/releases/latest
Download: https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/download/
Install: macOS and Linux: `curl -fsSL https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/install.sh | sh`. Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/install.ps1 | iex`, or download `Atlas-Setup.exe` (https://github.com/codeatlasdev/atlas/releases/latest/download/Atlas-Setup.exe: one click, per user, no admin rights; not code-signed yet, SmartScreen may warn: More info, then Run anyway). `atlas desktop` installs the desktop app.
Platforms: macOS 13+ on Apple silicon; Windows 10 (1809+) and 11 on x64; Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+; .deb, .rpm, Arch package, AppImage). Coming soon: Intel Macs, Windows on Arm (the x64 build runs emulated), Linux on Arm. macOS only: the native GPU terminal, capture/recording and agent test instances.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/getting-started/): install, first atlas.yaml, first run
- [Configuration](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/configuration/): every atlas.yaml field, validation, JSON Schema
- [Desktop](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/desktop/): spaces, worktrees, agents, project panel, logs, SSH hosts, keys
- [GPU terminal](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/terminal/): Metal renderer, images, shell integration, benchmarks
- [TUI](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/tui/): layout, keys, log viewer
- [CLI](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/cli/): commands, flags, exit codes
- [Agent setup](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/agents/): `atlas setup omp|claude-code|codex`
- [MCP](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/mcp/): tool reference and manual client setup
- [Runtime](https://atlas.codeatlas.com.br/docs/runtime/): startup order, restarts, shutdown, .logs/
